entries.title: Proceedings Calendar and System Review given independent civic destinations
entries.summary: The frontispiece now routes the Proceedings Calendar to Harmony and System Review to Balance as distinct public-record surfaces, while the Transparency Ledger remains an independent Society-wide record.
entries.sourceLabel: Utopian Society Corpus v2 · public-record topology

entries.title: Transparency Ledger made independently scrollable
entries.summary: The growing public chain now occupies a bounded, keyboard-focusable scroll region with visible focus treatment and accessible labeling, preserving the page around it as the record expands.
entries.sourceLabel: Utopian Society Corpus v2 · ledger interface

entries.title: Transparency Ledger automation activated
entries.summary: Civic events and completed releases can now register through duplicate-safe event keys. Safe retries return the original entry instead of creating another record, and the public ledger refreshes automatically while open.
